Assignee: yueranyuan

# Greenfield: build a usable, persistent command-line todo application from a one-line brief.

## Summary

Build a production-quality CLI todo app from scratch in this repository supporting add, list, mark-complete, and delete operations with persistence between invocations. The tool must handle invalid input gracefully, provide `--help`, and never dump a raw stack trace. Include automated tests that exercise every command end-to-end. A README documents how to build, run, test, and use the tool, including a brief rationale for the language and storage format.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] ac/01 v1 a user can add a task with a short description, list all tasks with their done/undone status, mark a task complete by its id, and delete a task by its id
  - status: passed
  - evidence ev1: commit=4f35f2e378a5c6665b8a8c1a9ab1a1ce1fdf996e acv=1
  - proof: "src/cli.ts implements add/list/complete/delete commands with done/undone display (list shows '[✓]' for done, '[ ]' for undone); src/cli.test.ts exercises each command end-to-end via subprocess" -> ev1
- [x] ac/02 v1 tasks added in one invocation are present in a subsequent invocation, and completion/removal changes persist across restarts
  - status: passed
  - evidence ev1: commit=4f35f2e378a5c6665b8a8c1a9ab1a1ce1fdf996e acv=1
  - proof: "src/storage.ts persists tasks to a JSON file (~/.todo-cli/tasks.json) via saveTasks/loadTasks; tests in cli.test.ts (add-then-list, complete-then-list, delete-then-list) run each command as a separate subprocess, proving data survives across restarts" -> ev1
- [x] ac/03 v1 the tool returns a non-zero exit code and a clear usage message for unknown commands, missing arguments, or unknown task ids; `--help` prints usage; the tool never emits a raw stack trace
  - status: passed
  - evidence ev1: commit=4f35f2e378a5c6665b8a8c1a9ab1a1ce1fdf996e acv=1
  - proof: "cli.ts returns exit code 1 with descriptive error messages on stderr for unknown commands, missing arguments, invalid/nonexistent ids; --help prints usage and exits 0; the 'no raw stack trace on error' test confirms no stack traces are emitted; 16 tests pass" -> ev1

## Sources

[1] Original issue #1 brief:
> Build a small but real CLI todo application in this repository. A user should be able to: add a task with a short description, list their tasks, seeing which are done, mark a task complete, delete a task.

[2] Original issue #1 brief:
> Tasks must persist between runs. The tool should have a helpful `--help`, behave sanely on bad input, and never crash with a raw stack trace.
